method.inputs: C1/C2 S0-S_avg-S_end and current C4 attribution, with terminal change bounded to [-2,2]
method.fallback: exact start+pressure if n>=4; otherwise bucketed start+pressure; otherwise bucketed start only
method.score_boundary: The comparator constrains R0-R4 only and never creates a process parent or directly sets an M3 grade.
method.source_bias_boundary: SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE is carried as coverage metadata and never treated as negative evidence.
